channel.title: SG HDB Resale - monthly market update
channel.description: What moved in Singapore's HDB resale market each month: the median price, the towns that rose and fell most, and the million-dollar count. From data.gov.sg records.

item.title: HDB resale market, September 2026: median $650,000 (+0.8% on the year)
item.description:
In September 2026 the median HDB resale flat sold for $650,000, up on August 2026 (+2.4%) and essentially flat on a year ago (+0.8%). 208 flats crossed the million-dollar mark, and 2,245 resales were recorded in all.

By flat type (July–September 2026, vs a year earlier): 3-room $435,000 (-3.3%); 4-room $628,000 (-0.3%); 5-room $740,944 (+0.1%); Executive $920,000 (+2.1%).

4-room prices rose most in Geylang +16.2%, Queenstown +7.8%, Toa Payoh +3.8%; fell most in Clementi -6.2%, Bukit Batok -4.7%, Woodlands -4.0% (July–September 2026, vs a year earlier).

The priciest resale of September 2026 was a 5-room in Central Area at $1,720,000. So far in 2026, 1,497 resales have crossed a million dollars - more than the 1,243 over the same months of 2025.
